summary: Phase 10 ChatGPT Control Layer testing completed. Verified authentication chain, scope enforcement, kill switch, READ_ONLY mode, approval flow, rollback, security measures, and frontend ChatGPT panel. Existing pytest suite passes 40/40 tests. Custom backend tests pass 46/51. Frontend panel fully functional with proper API key security (shown only once, never retrievable).
